resources.string: In the dcontrol web app, open Devices → Pair a phone, then point the camera at the QR code.
dcontrol uses the camera only to read the pairing QR code shown in your browser. No images are stored or sent.
Only continue if you started pairing yourself in your own browser. Once paired, this controller can manage this phone.
That is not a dcontrol pairing code.
This pairing code expired or was already used. Generate a new one in the web app.
Can\'t reach the controller. Check that the phone can open its address.
The controller rejected the pairing request.
This controller is on your local network. Allow dcontrol to connect to local network devices, then scan a new code. If Android no longer asks, allow it in the app\'s settings.
